prompt: High-fidelity user-interface design comp of a French personal budget web application, desktop screen, straight-on flat view, edge to edge, no device frame, no perspective. LAYOUT, top to bottom: a full-width dark carbon top bar holding the wordmark Plia on the left and three uppercase navigation tabs, the active one underlined in red; below it, on concrete ground, a full-width horizontal force diagram occupying the top third, read left to right: four evenly spaced upright black rod segments standing on a horizontal datum line, one per month, linked by taut thin red cords that sag or pull between them, each rod topped by a node dot with a leader line up to a month name and a projected euro balance, the datum line labelled at both ends, one rod drawn in red where the structure fails; below that a ruled band of four large readouts separated by hairline verticals; then the bottom half is a dense two-column ledger of thin ruled rows, incoming on the left and outgoing on the right, each row a label, a small black state chip and a right-aligned euro amount. VISUAL SYSTEM, identical in all regions: ground is flat poured-concrete grey #E6E3DF with a very fine grain; structural elements are matte carbon black #0D000F and graphite #2B2B2E; the single accent is tension red #D7262E used only for cords, negative figures and the active state; ash grey #9A9A9C for spent or slack values. Labels sit in small solid black chips with white uppercase condensed letters. Every panel is bounded by hairline rules, and every panel corner is notched (a small 45-degree cut), never rounded. Numbers are set in a technical monospace, tabular, right-aligned. Annotations connect to values by thin horizontal leader lines ending in a small open circle. A thin red diagonal slash marks the active control. Flat vector-crisp rendering: no drop shadows, no gradients, no glassmorphism, no pastel, no rounded cards, no pie or donut charts, no photography. French interface text, correctly accented, legible and sharp. Real interface words to render, in French: the product name Plia; navigation items Tableau de bord, Transactions, Historique; the labels Solde, Entrees, Sorties, Postes, Enveloppe, Report, Depassement, Projection, Reste; month names janvier, fevrier, mars, avril; amounts written like 2 480,00 € and -1 265,40 €.
